title: [v3-4-test] Upgrade important CI environment
body:
This PR upgrades important dependencies of the CI environment.

### Dependency floors

Raised:
- `boto3`, `botocore`: 1.42.95 → 1.42.96 (airflow-e2e-tests/pyproject.toml, providers/amazon/pyproject.toml, providers/hashicorp/pyproject.toml)

Skipped:
- `azure-ai-projects`: 2.5+ needs openai>=3, broke main (#73621, #73627)
- `azure-kusto-data`: held back by !=5.0.0 in providers/microsoft/azure/pyproject.toml
